test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following players is associated with billiards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pankaj Advani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pankaj Arjan Advani** is an Indian billiards and professional snooker player.
 
• Renowned for his exceptional talent, he has clinched the **International Billiards and Snooker Federation (IBSF) world championship** title a remarkable 27 times.
 
• Among his achievements are 18 billiards world titles, including 17 triumphs at the IBSF World Billiards Championship, along with one victory at the World Team Billiards Championship.
 
• In the realm of snooker, Advani has secured the IBSF World Snooker Championship thrice, in addition to two victories at the IBSF World Six-Red Championship.
 
• He has also claimed the titles of the IBSF World Team Cup and IBSF World Team Championship once each. Advani holds the record for the highest number of IBSF world championships.
 
• In acknowledgment of his remarkable accomplishments, Pankaj Advani has been honored with numerous awards by the Government of India.
 
• These accolades include the Arjuna Award bestowed upon him in 2004, the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna in 2006, the Padma Shri in 2009, and the prestigious Padma Bhushan in 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Saurabh Chaudhary **is an Indian sport shooter who clinched the gold medal at the 2018 Asian Games in the 10m Air Pistol event.
 
• **Manika Batra** is an Indian table tennis player who holds the position as the leading female table tennis player in India. As of May 2023, she ranks 39th globally in the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) rankings.
 
• **Sankalp Gupta** is recognized as a chess player.
